sloka: विधमेच्च पुरीं लङ्कां शोषयेच्च महोदधिम् ।रावणस्य च नीचस्य कीर्तिं नाम च नाशयेत् ।।५.२४.२२।।।।
transliteration: vidhamecca purīṁ laṅkāṁ śoṣayecca mahodadhim ।rāvaṇasya ca nīcasya kīrtiṁ nāma ca nāśayet ।।5.24.22।।।।

translations.english: "O Mythili I beseech you (to oblige Ravana). You have discharged your duty as a human being. Be happy. But you should also heed my advice which is, after all, salutary.
